blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Some of the biggest names on the Asian Tour–and the brightest talents the Philippines can offer–set out to win Asia’s oldest national golf championship when Manila Southwoods, which is being spruced up to perfect championship shape, hosts the 108th playing of the PH Open in just over a month. The Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) has stepped in to make sure that the event will be one to remember, putting up a $1 million (around P63 million) kitty for the 72-hole championship beginning Nov. 12 at the world-class Masters course of the SW complex in Carmona, Cavite.
